name: Skills library, the skill detail tabs, and the agent's Skills tab
description: Loads /skills and confirms a seeded skill card renders, opens it to the detail page and walks the Config / Preview / Versions tabs, then opens the Test Quality Reviewer's Skills tab and confirms its linked skill is listed and filterable. Exercises the skills list route, the detail route and its tab routing, the version-history fetch, and the agent skill-link fetch. Drag-reordering and the version diff are covered by unit tests instead — HTML5 drag is not reliably drivable here, and the diff is pure logic.

the card shows its agent count
